findings.description: best_score calls max() on possibly empty chunks without a guard, raising ValueError; it is now called from _log_best_score on every retrieval, including when retrieval returns no chunks.
findings.rationale: When self.rag.retrieve returns an empty list (a plausible case for an unmatched query), _log_best_score(chunks) calls best_score([]) which runs max() on an empty sequence and raises ValueError before the agent can reach should_abstain's empty-check. Previously should_abstain short-circuited on `not chunks`, so the empty case was handled; the new unconditional logging call makes the crash reachable on the normal path, so the question fails instead of abstaining.
